description: Resource schema for AWS::Route53GlobalResolver::CoreNetworkEndpoint. A core network endpoint connects a Route 53 Global Resolver to an AWS Cloud WAN core network and defines the private DNS IP addresses that Cloud WAN traffic uses to reach the resolver.

Region.markdownDescription:
---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 32  
Update requires: No interruption

ResourceName.markdownDescription:
---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 64  
Pattern: ^(?!^[0-9]+$)([a-zA-Z0-9-_/' ']+)$  
Update requires: No interruption

RegionScope.markdownDescription:
---

Required: No  
Type: String  
Allowed Values: ALL | REGIONAL  
Update requires: No interruption

IpAddress.description: A private DNS IP address of the core network endpoint. Specify exactly one of Ipv4Address or Ipv6Address. The IP address is the key of the entry: changing it adds the new address and then removes the old one.

Ipv4Address.markdownDescription:
---

Required: Conditional  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 15  
Pattern: ^((25[0-5]|(2[0-4]|1\d|[1-9]|)\d)\.?\b){4}$  
Update requires: No interruption

Ipv6Address.markdownDescription:
---

Required: Conditional  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 39  
Pattern: ^(?:[A-Fa-f0-9]{0,4}:){2,7}[A-Fa-f0-9]{1,4}$  
Update requires: No interruption

DnsLabel.description: Lowercase DNS label for the IP address. The service appends the endpoint ID to build the DNS name. The label of an existing IP address cannot be changed; to use a new label, change the IP address too.
DnsLabel.markdownDescription:
Lowercase DNS label for the IP address. The service appends the endpoint ID to build the DNS name. The label of an existing IP address cannot be changed; to use a new label, change the IP address too.

---

Required: Conditional  
Type: String  
Minimum Length: 1  
Maximum Length: 32  
Pattern: ^(?!-)[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,30}[a-z0-9])?$  
Update requires: No interruption

RegionScope.description: ALL to serve the IP address in every available region of the endpoint, or REGIONAL to serve it only in Regions.
RegionScope.markdownDescription:
ALL to serve the IP address in every available region of the endpoint, or REGIONAL to serve it only in Regions.

---

Required: Conditional  
Type:   
Update requires: No interruption

Regions.description: Regions that serve the IP address. Required when RegionScope is REGIONAL and not allowed when it is ALL. Must be a subset of AvailableRegions.
Regions.markdownDescription:
Regions that serve the IP address. Required when RegionScope is REGIONAL and not allowed when it is ALL. Must be a subset of AvailableRegions.
